recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, sepia-toned or monochrome close-up portrait of a male vocalist in a recording studio, featuring a prominent microphone pop filter in the foreground and bold, two-tone typography in the upper right quadrant.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject's face occupies the left two-thirds of the frame.
Microphone pop filter acts as a circular visual anchor in the lower right.
Typography is stacked vertically in the dark negative space of the upper right.
High-contrast lighting emphasizes the texture of the patterned shirt and facial features.
coreInvariants: Monochrome or desaturated sepia color palette for the image.
Presence of studio equipment (pop filter/mic stand).

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Extreme close-up, subject positioned off-center to the left, filling the vertical height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The circular pop filter in the bottom right provides a geometric counterpoint to the organic shapes of the face.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the subject's face, moves down to the microphone, then up to the bright typography in the top right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Deep shadows in the upper right provide a clean canvas for text legibility.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Desaturated sepia/black and white for the photographic base.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep black for the background shadows.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant lime green or bright yellow for the primary text.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the dark background and the bright, saturated text.
paletteRestrictions: Limit photographic colors to grayscale or sepia tones.
Text must use high-visibility neon or primary colors.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Geometric sans-serif and casual brush script.
letterConstructionRules: Primary text: Heavy weight, uniform stroke, all-caps.
Secondary text: Slanted, cursive script with varying line weights.
characterSpecificRedesigns: None; relies on standard font geometry for clarity.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High contrast pairing of a rigid, heavy sans-serif with a fluid, organic script.

avoid: Using multiple bright colors for the script

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the weight and geometric feel of the primary text.
Captures the casual, handwritten feel of the subtitle.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast, sepia-toned close-up photograph of a man with sunglasses and a patterned shirt in a recording studio, with a microphone pop filter in the bottom right foreground and a dark, empty space in the top right.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add bold, uppercase sans-serif text in lime green at the top right, followed by white script text underneath, both aligned to the left within their block.

verificationChecks: Is the image monochrome or sepia?
Is the primary text a bright, contrasting color?
Is the microphone pop filter visible in the foreground?
Is the text placed in the dark area of the background?

adjustableVariables: Specific hue of the accent text (yellow vs green)
Tightness of the crop on the face
mustRedesign: Original artist names and specific song titles
Any specific studio brand logos on the equipment
Exact facial features of the original subject
postGenerationChecks: Text is legible against the background.
The pop filter does not overlap the subject's mouth.
The color palette remains cohesive (sepia + 1 accent color).
The script font feels handwritten rather than formal.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a high-contrast monochrome studio portrait with a two-tier typographic system: a bold, neon-colored sans-serif for the main name and a white script for the secondary title, positioned in the upper right negative space.
